name: TeamStarWolf - Threat Group: Scattered Spider (G1015)
description: ATT&CK-documented techniques attributed to Scattered Spider (G1015; aliases: Roasted 0ktapus, Octo Tempest, Storm-0875, UNC3944). Sourced directly from MITRE's intrusion-set to technique 'uses' relationships in the bundled ATT&CK v16 data - this is MITRE's own attribution, not a curated TeamStarWolf mapping. Every row is documented group use (score 100). Absence of a technique does not mean the group cannot use it; it means MITRE has not documented it.
